upheld.title: Local `message` hides the `message` parameter in callBasket
upheld.detail: callBasket(method, message: Buffer) declares `const message = decodeURIComponent(...)` inside its 'end' handler, which hides the request-body parameter of the same name. It works, but readers can confuse the request bytes with the gRPC status text.
